meta.title: Support
meta.description: Interfy support center: reach our team by chat, email, or phone, or find answers in our FAQ.

hero.description: Our technical support team follows your operation every business day, with an SLA defined per plan and a help center always available.

items.title: Live chat
items.description: Talk in real time with our support team, Monday to Friday, 8am to 8pm.

items.title: Email
items.description: Send your question or request to suporte@interfy.ai and get a reply within your plan's SLA.

items.title: Phone
items.description: Call our support center during business hours for urgent cases.

items.title: Help center
items.description: Browse articles, tutorials, and step-by-step guides for every Interfy product.

items.question: How do I open a support ticket?
items.answer: You can open a ticket via chat, email (suporte@interfy.ai), or directly from the Interfy dashboard's support section. Every ticket gets a tracking number.

items.question: What's the support response time?
items.answer: The SLA varies by plan: Starter accounts get a reply within 24 business hours, while Business, Corporate, and Enterprise plans get priority with shorter SLAs, detailed in the contract.

items.question: Is support included in every plan?
items.answer: Yes. Chat and email support is included in every paid plan. Corporate and Enterprise plans also get a dedicated account manager.

items.question: What are the support hours?
items.answer: Our support runs Monday to Friday, 8am to 8pm (Brasília time). Enterprise accounts can add extended 24/7 support.

items.question: How do I track platform availability?
items.answer: Availability and incident history for every product are published in real time on our platform status page.

items.question: How do I escalate an urgent ticket?
items.answer: Tickets marked as critical are automatically prioritized. If you need to reinforce urgency, reply to the ticket email or call our support center.

cta.heading: Still have questions?
cta.subheading: Talk to one of our specialists and see how Interfy can adapt to your operation.
